fullPassage: Showing up late for work and using abusive language are the kinds of problems that every business wants to eliminate. Business leaders looking to achieve this often focus on finding "bad apples" who break their rules and then punishing them. This assumes that the bad apples are acting badly on purpose. In fact, one common reason that employees give for breaking rules is that they were unaware their behavior was undesirable. There are some actors who knowingly act against policy, but many problems are unintentional failings. If businesses want better employees, those businesses must create clear standards and educate their employees directly about how to follow them. Without these standards there would be no way to distinguish bad apples from merely uninformed apples.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 against policy(정책에 반하여): 알면서도 정책에 반하여 행동한다는 문맥
det.analysis:
① for work(직장을 위해): 문맥 부적합
② against policy: act against policy ←정답
③ on purpose(고의로): 앞 문장에 이미 등장
④ without standards(기준 없이): 문맥 부적합
det.tip: act against policy = 정책에 반하여 행동하다

questions.passage: Showing up late for work and using abusive language are the kinds of problems that every business wants to eliminate. Business leaders looking to achieve this often focus on finding "bad apples" who break their rules and then punishing them. This assumes that the bad apples are acting badly on purpose. In fact, one common reason that employees give for breaking rules is that they were unaware their behavior was undesirable. There are some actors who knowingly act against policy, but many problems are unintentional failings. If businesses want better employees, those businesses must create clear standards and educate their employees directly about how to follow them. Without these standards there would be no way to distinguish bad apples from merely uninformed apples.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① 항상 의도적+교육 불필요: 원문은 many are unintentional + must educate ←불일치
det.analysis:
① 항상 의도적+교육 불필요: 반대 주장 ←정답
② 고의 가정: This assumes acting badly on purpose 일치
③ 일부 고의+많은 비의도: some knowingly + many unintentional 일치
④ 기준+교육: must create standards and educate 일치
det.tip: 원문: many problems are unintentional + must educate

ch: 직원의 규칙 위반은 항상 의도적인 것이므로 교육은 불필요하다.
기업 지도자들은 나쁜 직원이 고의로 행동한다고 가정하는 경향이 있다.
일부 직원은 알면서도 정책에 반하여 행동하지만 많은 문제는 비의도적이다.
기업은 명확한 기준을 만들어 직원을 직접 교육해야 한다.

In fact, one common reason that employees give for breaking rules is that they were unaware their behavior was undesirable. questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 교육으로 문제 감소: must educate employees directly 일치
det.analysis:
① 기준 없이 운영: Without standards no way to distinguish ←불일치
② 교육으로 감소: must educate ←정답
③ 성격 결함: 본문에 언급 없음 ←불일치
④ 모든 고의+처벌 유일: many unintentional ←불일치
det.tip: must create clear standards and educate their employees directly

ch: 기업은 명확한 기준 없이도 효과적으로 운영될 수 있다.
직원들에게 규칙을 직접 교육하면 문제 행동을 줄일 수 있다.
직장 내 문제 행동은 개인의 성격 결함에서만 비롯된다.
모든 직원은 규칙을 고의로 어기므로 처벌만이 유일한 해결책이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 directly(직접): 직원을 직접 교육해야 한다는 문맥
det.analysis:
① badly(나쁘게): educate badly 부적합
② knowingly(알면서): educate knowingly 문맥 부적합
③ merely(단지): educate merely 문맥 부적합
④ directly: educate their employees directly ←정답
det.tip: educate ... directly = 직접 교육하다
